profile.subtitleJa: マナセ族の系譜に現れる名。
profile.summaryJa: ヨシュア記17:2のマナセ氏族一覧に、ヘフェルの氏族が挙げられます。

facts.textJa: ヨシュア記17:3では、ゼロフェハドがヘフェルの子として記され、息子を持たず五人の娘がいたと述べられます。

profile.historicalRoleJa: マナセ族の家系名の一つ。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

review.identityCheckJa: JOS17:2は「ヘフェルの子ら」を一族名として挙げ、17:3はゼロフェハドをヘフェルの子とする。家系文脈は一致するが、本人の行為は記されない。
